segments.name: Diagnostics
products: OraQuick ® HCV Rapid Antibody Test and Self-Test
segments.description: Develops, manufactures, markets and sells rapid point-of-care diagnostics and sample collection devices to laboratories, hospitals, clinics, public health organizations, distributors and consumers.
segments.evidence: The Company is organized on the basis of products and services into a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Clinical laboratories, hospitals, clinics, public health organizations, distributors, government agencies and physicians' offices pay for diagnostics products and for sample management solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: These products are sold in the United States and internationally to various clinical laboratories, hospitals, clinics, community-based organizations, and other public health organizations, distributors, government agencies, physicians' offices, and commercial and industrial entities.
